workflow_metadata.description: Workflow for adding or updating a service/system/feature in an existing system of systems, integrating architecture and development phases with explicit delta tracking.

system_isolation.mandatory_check: ALWAYS verify working directory is /home/ajs7/project/saa/systems/<system_name> before ANY operation
system_isolation.working_directory_rule: cd to systems/<system_name> at the start of EVERY phase and subphase
system_isolation.path_verification: pwd must equal /home/ajs7/project/saa/systems/<system_name> before file operations
cross_contamination_prevention: NEVER reference or modify files in other system directories
All file paths must be relative to current system directory or absolute with verified system_name
Before reading ANY file, verify it contains the current system_name in its path
If you find yourself in wrong system directory, STOP immediately and return to correct directory
system_isolation.context_file_location: ALL context files (current_focus.md, working_memory.json, etc.) MUST be in systems/<system_name>/
system_isolation.sanity_check: If system_name from working_memory.json doesn't match pwd, ERROR and STOP

validation_before_every_operation: CONFIRM: No files from other systems will be modified
refresh_sequence: SAVE: Update progress tracker and working memory
CONFIRM: State system name, phase, subphase, next action
degradation_signals: Asking about system name when it's in working_memory.json
pwd does not match system_name from working_memory.json

entry_conditions.context_refresh: MANDATORY before starting (reload all context, validate working directory, confirm system_name)

phases.name: Change Proposal & Impact Analysis
phases.description: Capture the intent, scope, and initial impact of the new or updated service/system/feature.
actions: Document change proposal (feature, service, or system addition/update)
Identify affected services/systems/interfaces
Initial impact analysis: dependencies, data flows, contracts, deployment, compliance
Update process_log.md with proposal and impact summary

phases.name: Architecture Re-Engineering & Decomposition
phases.description: Apply relevant steps from architecture_workflow.json to decompose, update, and validate the new/changed architecture.
actions: Decompose new/updated service/system using UAF/architecture templates
Update or create service_architecture.json for new/changed services
Deduce/validate interfaces (ICDs) and update contracts
Update system graph (system_of_systems_graph.py) and validate for cycles, orphans, bottlenecks
Update index.json and build_ready_index.json to reflect new/changed services
Context refresh after each major artifact update

phases.name: Delta Highlighting & Approval
phases.description: Summarize all changes (deltas) to architecture, interfaces, and contracts. Obtain approval if required.
actions: Generate delta report: new/modified/removed services, interfaces, contracts, data models, deployment, compliance
Highlight all downstream impacts (integration, test, deployment, compliance)
Update process_log.md with delta summary
Obtain stakeholder approval if required

phases.name: Development Bootstrap & Implementation
phases.description: Apply development workflow steps for new/updated services, using service_development_workflow.json with operational testing requirements.
actions: Run bootstrap_development_context.py for new/updated services
Initialize dev_progress_tracker.json, dev_working_memory.json, dev_current_focus.md
Create/update operational mission artifacts for new features: mission statement deltas, user scenarios, success criteria
Scaffold code, implement new/updated logic, update tests, docs, configs
Develop operational test scenarios that validate new features deliver user value
Implement both development testing (built correctly) and operational testing (right thing built)
Enforce quality gates including MISSION_VALIDATION and USER_ACCEPTANCE for new features
Update dev_process_log.md and dev_context_checkpoint.md after each major step

new_features.mission_validation: Define how new feature aligns with and enhances system mission
new_features.user_impact_scenarios: Create concrete scenarios showing how users benefit from new feature
new_features.success_measurement: Define measurable criteria for feature effectiveness
new_features.integration_scenarios: Test how new feature integrates with existing user workflows

updated_features.delta_mission_analysis: Analyze how changes affect system mission and user value
updated_features.user_workflow_impact: Validate that changes improve rather than degrade user experience
updated_features.backward_compatibility: Ensure changes don't break existing user scenarios
updated_features.migration_scenarios: Test user transition from old to new feature behavior

phases.name: Integration, Validation & Release Preparation
phases.description: Integrate new/updated services, validate end-to-end including operational effectiveness, and prepare for release.
actions: Update integration tests and scenarios to include new/updated services
Run system graph and architecture validation tools
Validate all contracts, data models, and deployment artifacts
Execute operational test scenarios to validate feature effectiveness and user value
Validate mission alignment: ensure new/updated features enhance system mission achievement
Conduct user acceptance validation using feature_user_scenarios.md
Measure success criteria defined in feature_success_criteria.md
Update system-level operational artifacts to reflect feature changes
Update documentation and runbooks as needed
Prepare release notes highlighting user benefits and operational improvements
Create migration instructions if required, focusing on user experience

FEATURE_MISSION_ALIGNMENT.requirement: New/updated features demonstrably enhance system mission achievement
FEATURE_MISSION_ALIGNMENT.validation: Execute mission validation scenarios and measure improvement

USER_SCENARIO_VALIDATION.requirement: All feature user scenarios execute successfully and deliver expected value
USER_SCENARIO_VALIDATION.validation: Run through each scenario in feature_user_scenarios.md

SUCCESS_CRITERIA_ACHIEVEMENT.requirement: Feature meets or exceeds success criteria defined in feature_success_criteria.md
SUCCESS_CRITERIA_ACHIEVEMENT.validation: Measure each success criterion and document results

SYSTEM_INTEGRATION_VALIDATION.requirement: New features integrate seamlessly with existing user workflows
SYSTEM_INTEGRATION_VALIDATION.validation: Test end-to-end user journeys that span old and new features

operational_testing_artifacts.purpose: Ensure new/updated features deliver user value and enhance system mission, not just meet technical specifications

feature_mission_deltas.purpose: Document how new/updated features align with and enhance system mission
template: **Feature Name:** [Name of new or updated feature]
- [Mission capabilities this feature enables or improves]
**Success Indicators:** [How we'll know mission is enhanced]
**Potential Mission Risks:** [How feature could compromise mission]

feature_user_scenarios.purpose: Define concrete user workflows that validate feature effectiveness
template: **Usage Context:** [When and why users will use this feature]
**Cross-Feature Workflows:** [How this feature works with existing features]
**End-to-End User Journeys:** [Complete workflows involving this feature]

feature_success_criteria.purpose: Define measurable criteria for feature effectiveness validation

development_testing.purpose: Validate feature is built correctly according to specifications

operational_testing.purpose: Validate feature delivers user value and enhances mission
operational_testing.focus: User effectiveness, mission alignment, value delivery

testing_balance.principle: Features must pass both development testing (built correctly) AND operational testing (right thing built)

delta_tracking.delta_report: Summarizes all changes to architecture, interfaces, contracts, data models, deployment, compliance, and operational testing requirements.
delta_tracking.delta_summary.json: Machine-readable summary of all deltas for downstream automation.

operational_deltas.mission_impact: How feature changes affect system mission achievement
operational_deltas.user_workflow_changes: Impact on existing user scenarios and workflows
operational_deltas.success_criteria_updates: New or modified success criteria for feature validation

delta_tracking.context_refresh: MANDATORY after each delta artifact is created or updated.

trigger_conditions: Artifact category change (e.g., from architecture to dev, or ICD to code)
After each major artifact update (service_architecture.json, ICD, index.json, build_ready_index.json, code scaffold, etc.)
After each development stage for new/updated services
If context drift or token saturation detected
sequence: SAVE: Update progress tracker and working memory
SNAPSHOT: regenerate context_checkpoint.md summarizing current state and deltas
CONFIRM: State system name, phase, subphase, next action

phases: Integration, Validation & Release Preparation (with operational validation)
quick_reference.context_refresh: MANDATORY after each major step, delta artifact update, or any refresh trigger
before_every_operation: 4. Confirm: system name, phase, subphase, next action
key_principles: Update progress tracking after each operation
Validate frequently (every 5-7 services or after major deltas)
Request source code when making recommendations
Create operational testing artifacts for all new/updated features
Validate features deliver user value, not just meet technical specifications
Ensure features enhance system mission achievement
Balance development testing (built correctly) with operational testing (right thing built)

for_new_features: Create feature_user_scenarios.md with concrete user workflows
Create feature_success_criteria.md with measurable validation criteria
Develop operational test scenarios that validate user value
Execute mission validation to ensure feature enhances system purpose
for_updated_features: Analyze mission impact of changes in feature_mission_deltas.md
Update user scenarios to reflect workflow improvements
Define success criteria that measure improvement over previous version
Test backward compatibility and user transition scenarios
Validate that updates enhance rather than degrade user experience
validation_gates: FEATURE_MISSION_ALIGNMENT: Feature demonstrably enhances system mission
USER_SCENARIO_VALIDATION: All user scenarios execute successfully
SUCCESS_CRITERIA_ACHIEVEMENT: Feature meets measurable success criteria
SYSTEM_INTEGRATION_VALIDATION: Feature integrates seamlessly with existing workflows
